The standard test-plan §3 set follows in its order (`capability-drift` before the default-features workspace nextest; the `--features mcp-server` bindings regen as the last cargo-adjacent step; the base-identity bindings close, since no procedure is added), then the operator pass. Every Rust gate runs: no entry is deferred, because the xtask test `license_npm_manifest_and_lock_root_agree` (`xtask/src/license_check.rs:97`) reads the lockfile this chunk changes, and the directive allows every step tonight (inputs#I1).
Order inside the webview block: `npm run build` precedes `npm run test`, because `src/contrast/parse-tokens.test.ts` reads `dist/tokens.css` (research.md §Measured).

Absences, each with its reason: - No boot-path file is touched (`main.rs`, `observability.rs`, `crates/ui-bridge/src/`, `tauri.conf.json`, `capabilities/*.json`; the scope-guard entry proves it), so the boot smoke does not bind (test-plan §3 Boot-smoke gate). - No live leg: no app boots. - No headful self-verify: `cargo xtask self-verify` is a Windows/WRY harness and does not run on this Linux host, and the chunk changes no UI source, token or component. The built bundle's hashes are recorded instead (the report-only `sha256sum` entry). - The full a11y chain (`cargo xtask test:a11y`) is not listed locally: research did not run it on this host. Its witness is the CI `a11y` job on Linux, macOS and Windows, which installs this lockfile, builds and runs the chain; the CI read asserts it green. The local reading is the config-named suite listing. - `cargo xtask pre-push:linux` cannot run on the Linux dev host (it drives every stage through `wsl.exe`); porting it is its own route entry. Its `npm` stage's two commands, `npm ci` and `npm run build`, are listed here directly. - The PLAIN `npm ci` is not a gate on this host. At P5 it read exit 1: puppeteer 24.43.1's postinstall fails because `~/.cache/puppeteer/chrome/linux-148.0.7778.97` exists without its executable. That is the standing PC22 defect, owned by CARRY (a) on the route entry "pre-push:linux runs natively on Linux" (founder ruling 2026-10-04: isolate the cache under `target/`, never delete the shared one). The listed form sets `PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=1`, which touches no cache and skips a browser download this chunk does not use; the isolated-cache form is not re-runnable (the CARRY records that a second `npm ci` against it fails). CI's runners install the plain form. - `cargo auditable build --workspace --release` is not listed locally (`cargo auditable` is not installed on this host). The CI `supply-chain` job runs it, and the CI read asserts that job green. - `npm ls --all` is not a gate: it exits 1 on `invalid: proxy-agent@6.5.0` at the chunk base and on a fresh install alike (research.md §Measured).
